items.hook: Aspects of Love is a novel by author David Garnett centering on the loves of a young soldier named Alexis Golightly, his uncle George Dillingham, and the beautiful actress Rose Vibert from whom neither man could escape.
items.body: It was originally published in 1955. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Wasmiyah Leaves The Sea is a 1986 novel by the Kuwaiti author Laila Al-Othman.
items.body: The novel was adapted into a successful movie in 1996, a decade after its publication date. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: The Leper of Saint Giles is a medieval mystery novel by Ellis Peters, set in October 1139.
items.body: It is the fifth novel in The Cadfael Chronicles and was first published in 1981. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
